inputs.case_id: sha256(utf8(corpus_id + NUL + sent_id + NUL + edit_type + NUL + one_based_source_position))
inputs.order: corpus_order, then byte-frozen source-file row order
inputs.ordered_case_sha256_algorithm: sha256 over one LF-terminated UTF-8 record per case: corpus_id NUL position NUL case_id NUL sent_id NUL edit_type NUL sha256(sentence_original UTF-8)

qwen.license: Apache-2.0 as emitted by ollama show
qwen.attempt_policy: generate attempts in ascending order and stop immediately at the first passing output; retain that passing output; retain metadata and reason codes for every failed generated attempt; generate no later attempt after a pass
qwen.seed_derivation: first 31 bits of sha256(utf8(str(master_seed) + ':' + case_id + ':' + str(attempt_index))) interpreted big-endian

prompts.system: You generate one controlled rewrite for a sentence-specificity sensitivity study. Follow only the requested rewrite direction. Preserve the sentence's main proposition, polarity, modality, and communicative intent. Use general world knowledge only; do not assume hidden document context. Do not mention this task, scores, models, labels, authors, or editing instructions. Return only the required JSON object with edited_sentence and no explanation.
prompts.blindness_contract: Each request contains only the fixed system prompt, the direction-matched template, and sentence_original. Corpus identity, sent_id, author edit, all scores, all labels, failure outcomes from other attempts, and other cases are absent.

automated_gates.role: outcome-blind safeguards only; they are not human or factual validation
automated_gates.normalization: Unicode NFKC, strip outer whitespace, collapse internal whitespace only for comparisons; stored passing text preserves model content after outer stripping
automated_gates.content_tokens: casefold word tokens of length at least 3 excluding the frozen English stopword list in the implementation

add_specific.required_change: edited token count is at least original plus 2 OR edited concrete-marker count is at least original plus 1

de_specify.required_change: edited token count is at most original minus 2 OR edited concrete-marker count is at most original minus 1

automated_gates.failure_handling: A failed attempt is never repaired or manually edited. The next predeclared seeded attempt uses the identical prompt in a fresh context. A case with no passing attempt is excluded and fully accounted for by corpus, direction, attempt, and reason code.

coverage_gate.below_gate_action: score accepted outputs and package coverage/failures, but stop paper-facing source-comparison inference; do not tune prompts, thresholds, or attempts

scoring.score_blindness: No scorer is invoked until generation and gating complete for all 60 planned cases. Scorer outputs are not summarized or comparatively inspected until every required accepted-row score file passes identity, coverage, finiteness, range, and exact-join gates.
scoring.sources_scored: author edited text for all 60 cases and accepted Qwen edited text; originals use frozen full-corpus scorer outputs except GranuScore, whose frozen controlled-edit original scores are exact joins

ko.checkpoint_inference: load each retained per-corpus run checkpoint without retraining; compute shallow-feature normalization and vocabulary from the same frozen full original target-corpus input used for that checkpoint; score author and accepted-Qwen query texts through the unmodified official test path with the existing one-row compensation
ko.secondary_aggregate: rowwise arithmetic mean of the three run scores
ko.identity_boundary: three stochastic instances of the approved maintained post-publication implementation; failed exact-2019 evidence remains immutable

granuscore.no_unit_rule: retain official NO_FACT_SCORE percentile, flag, and report coverage

scoring.qwen_rubric_self_judgment: not run; self-judgment of generated edits would be circular and cannot enter primary inclusion or response comparisons
scoring.required_join: one-to-one case_id and source_sent_id; exact author/Qwen source labels; original score identical within model/run and case; every accepted Qwen case has every required score; no duplicate, missing, nonfinite, or out-of-range value

analysis.analysis_set: accepted Qwen cases only, with both author and Qwen arms paired to the same original; unmatched author cases appear only in all-author descriptive summaries and coverage accounting
analysis.cell: model instance by corpus_id by edit_type
paired_source_estimands: mean of Qwen delta minus author delta
mean of absolute Qwen delta minus absolute author delta
Qwen expected-direction response rate minus author rate
analysis.irrelevant_rewrite_rule: report signed and absolute delta; do not impose an arbitrary success threshold

bootstrap.unit: controlled-edit case within corpus_id and edit_type
bootstrap.joint_resampling: one index draw is applied jointly to author and Qwen arms and all model instances/runs in the cell

analysis.multiplicity: descriptive; no p-values, winner selection, superiority, noninferiority, or accuracy claims
analysis.scale_rule: compare direction and magnitude only within each native model/run; never compare raw deltas across SpeciTeller, Ko, and GranuScore scales
analysis.reporting: coverage and failure reasons by corpus and direction precede outcomes; report every arm/cell including unfavorable or sign-reversed results
analysis.claim_boundary: The comparison tests edit-generator/source robustness of scorer responses. Synthetic Qwen edits are not human-validated for factual correctness, semantic preservation, or a single-factor specificity change. Automated gates are safeguards, not validation.

outputs.release_boundary: Tracked compact evidence contains case IDs, corpus/direction/source labels, aggregate tables, hashes, counts, and scorer values needed for audit, but no original sentence, author edit, Qwen generated text, human labels, participant information, or absolute host paths. Text-bearing raw inputs/outputs and nonredistributable Ko checkpoints stay ignored.

stop_conditions: protocol, input, model/blob/runtime, scorer image, checkpoint, original-score, or prior GranuScore artifact identity mismatch
source row count, direction count, case identity, ordered-case digest, or original-text hash mismatch
any generation request exposes a forbidden field or any resume row has a mismatched protocol/model/input identity
coverage falls below the frozen gate, in which case scoring continues for accepted rows but paper-facing source-comparison inference stops
any required accepted-row scorer coverage or exact join fails
any nonfinite or out-of-range score occurs
a prompt, attempt, gate, inclusion, scoring, join, bootstrap, estimand, reporting, or claim rule would need to change after generation or scorer outcome inspection
